title: Invoice Preview + Pricing Sandbox for Per-Token Cost Attribution
creator: Ava Morgan
description: Design an "Invoice Preview" panel and a linked "Pricing Sandbox" inside Redwood Console that lets engineers and finance stakeholders inspect token-level cost attribution, simulate pricing changes, and export reconciliable line-items. The goal is to enable an easy-to-understand, exportable snapshot of per-route/per-model token consumption, applied multipliers (e.g., model tier, quantization), discounts, and final invoice line-items so teams can forecast and reconcile spend without a separate billing tool.
acceptance_criteria: Invoice Preview UI renders per-route and per-model line items with clear token breakdown (prompt/response/system) and applied rate per token
Pricing Sandbox allows toggling pricing inputs (base rate, volume discounts, reserved capacity offsets, per-model multipliers) and shows immediate delta to total and per-line items
Export supports CSV and JSON with normalized columns for token counts, applied rates, discount rules, computed subtotal and tax placeholder
Role-aware filters: Finance role sees condensed invoice rows; Engineers can expand to per-request samples and prompt fingerprints
Prototype validated in 3 usability sessions with at least 80% of participants completing the ‘reconcile a $5k discrepancy’ task within 6 minutes
Telemetry hooks documented (event names and properties) for toggles, export, and simulation runs so usage and confusion points can be instrumented
decisions: Expose pricing inputs in a sandbox modal rather than inline to prevent accidental changes to real billing settings
Show both aggregated invoice rows and expandable request samples — default to aggregated for Finance, expanded for Engineers
Use a read-only 'Apply to forecast' flow that outputs a new simulated_invoice_id instead of mutating customer configuration
CSV export will include a human-friendly 'explanation' column summarizing which pricing rule(s) produced the final rate per line
We will not attempt tax calculation; include a tax placeholder and guidance copy linking to billing/legal
tasks: 0. Kickoff with PM and Billing: align on required export columns and sample formats
1. Wireframes: create single-column compact invoice and two-column engineer view
2. Prototype: interactive Figma prototype showing sandbox toggles and CSV download
3. Usability testing: recruit 6 Finance + 6 Engineers, run moderated sessions
4. Handoff: pixel assets, component specs, copy, and accessibility notes
5. Review: PM/Eng/Legal sign off on export schema and privacy guidance
6. Iterate: incorporate feedback and finalize for engineering implementation
